text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold positions that were above my average cost; I should not let the comfort of locking in gains make me sell winners automatically or hold losers just to avoid admitting a mistake.","I should judge the whole portfolio and each holding by its future prospects and risk—not by whether its separate account is above or below my purchase price.","Past price moves do not predict future moves, so I should make decisions from my plan, diversification and risk limits rather than frequent checking or short-term fluctuations."]}
